newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile sells 217 tonnes of nickel.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile sells 217 tonnes of nickel.

text.p: Defense National Stockpile Center said its sold 480,000 lbs or 217.7 tonnes of nickel to three companies at an average price of $3.145 a lb.
BenMet bought 240,000 lbs at prices ranging from $3.166 to $3.146.
Keywell bought 200,000 lb at $3.136, and Abbey Metal Corp bought 40,000 lbs at $3.1313.
The total value of the sale was $1,509,892.
LME cash nickel officially settled at $3.238 Friday.
The next bid opening for nickel is Feb 13.
